sources.title: What to know about the Canadian and US wildfires and their impact

facts.claim: Wildfires in Canada and the US cause smoke pollution, affecting air quality and prompting evacuations. Rising temperatures and climate change contribute to more frequent and intense fires, creating tension between communities and emergency responders.
Wildfires continue to spread across North America, impacting air quality and prompting health advisories as climate change exacerbates the crisis.
